Type: side table with bookshelf
Use: holding a lamp, drinks and books beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, industrial, modern
Materials: wood veneer with oak grain, black metal frame leg
Colors: warm dark walnut brown, black
Shape: rectangular top, solid side panel with open cubby shelves on one end, black metal rectangular leg frame on the other, middle shelf, compact and asymmetric
Feel: practical, warm, tidy
Goes with: dark wood, black metal, cream walls; modern or industrial living rooms and reading corners

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Side Table with Bookshelf, 21.6"W, Black Oak
product.description: This square table brings functionality to any room with 1 side devoted to shelving that is great for storing books or other items. The height allows it to be used as a side table or a small desk. Butt joints connect the legs and shelving, adding a modern look to the sleek black finish. 21.6"W x 21.6"D x 25.6"H Engineered wood with metal This stylish table offers a modern look and functionality great for any room. Shelving on 1 side of this table makes it great as a side table or a desk in any room. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Wipe with a soft cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
